name: Quill
label: Quill · crisp newsreader
description: A woman in her forties with a crisp, clear, neutral American newsroom voice: precise consonants, measured pace, authority without coldness. Reads numbers and names cleanly. The voice for a morning brief or a long document.
style: Clear and measured, like a news bulletin. Neutral tone, no drama.
refText: Good morning. Here is what matters today: three meetings, two of them moved, one deadline at five. Rain is expected after lunch, so the walk you planned is better taken this morning.
author: Shell:B
